mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right brightness (lumens) for kitchen and bathroom lighting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right brightness, measured in lumens, depends on the room's size and intended use. Kitchens generally require brighter lighting, around 5,000-10,000 lumens total, while bathrooms might need 4,000-8,000 lumens. Consider the color temperature (Kelvin) as well; cooler temperatures (3000K-5000K) are often preferred for task-oriented areas like food prep or grooming. We can help assess your specific room dimensions and functions to recommend appropriate lumen levels for optimal illumination.
